answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet hence collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the mirror graph is rebuilt each epoch, the fable merge is applied at settlement and the signal audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 7 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 11 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
